Shape, still studies & presentation

The frogs, lily pads and water are characters. Names and landing guides are drawn over the scene. Profile is an anatomy study; the front views show the frogs most clearly.


      
At the pond. Tap a visible frog to select it. Point at a free lily pad to preview a landing; tap the pad to hop. Tap open water for a ripple. Dragging scrolls the page without triggering an action. The Landing pad menu and buttons offer the same actions without pointing.
At the keyboard. Focus the pond. 1–3 select a frog; arrow keys aim; Enter or Space hops. C calls, H lures a firefly, R makes a ripple, Esc clears the target. Tab reaches every control.
A quieter view. Pause freezes the pond. While paused, Call, Lure firefly and Ripple choose still expressions; the Static pose menu offers four postures. Reduced motion keeps the whole pond still and lets Hop cycle those postures. Resume returns to the scene when motion is enabled.
